joins: each InvoiceLine to its Track, on TrackId (declared key)
each Track to its Genre, on GenreId (declared key)
measures: tracks sold: total of InvoiceLine quantity
order: highest tracks sold first, then lowest Genre id first, top 1
planner_note: Sum quantities sold per genre and keep the largest.
text: Shows Genre name and tracks sold, by Genre id and Genre name. Reads InvoiceLine, Track and Genre. Highest tracks sold first, then lowest Genre id first, top 1.
